label: cali_arousal_state
note: live session arousal tracking. separate from config. written by arousal commands during session. schema v2 added stim_mode/recovery/persistence. schema v3 (2026-04-19): float arousal, break_triggers_log, override TTL stamp.

post_orgasm_recovery.rule: while active, arousal is floor-clamped per cali_arousal_config.json → post_orgasm_recovery.rules.floor_clamp_by_stage. re-stim during recovery jumps 1-3 tiers and can restart the sequence.

persistence.rule: arousal decays between turns without stim. peaks ≥ threshold set an echo window during which voice retains residue and boot flags [echo].
